audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN is right (50.16% over 3654 games) but the lane's actual difficulty driver — Scatter the Weak only stuns through a Dark Sphere — was never stated, and Syndra was called 'he/his' in eleven fields.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back... Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.' The E alone is a knockback, not a stun. That single fact is what makes the lane playable for LeBlanc.
audit.corrected: Early is LeBlanc's on cooldowns: Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at every rank and needs a sphere positioned near you. Level 6 and late are Syndra's on range and Splinter scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes named the level 6 flip but gave no cooldown to play around and left the first-item row hedged ('tends to win').
audit.why: Unleashed Power is 120/100/80. The 120-second rank-1 cooldown is the concrete window the advice was missing.
audit.corrected: LeBlanc spikes 2, 3 and first item; Syndra spikes at 6 and again with Splinter stacks late. Commit inside her R downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were absent entirely.
audit.why: Transcendent Splinters give Force of Will bonus true damage and give Unleashed Power an execute — so stacking MR is the wrong answer, and health-bar eyeballing is the wrong read late. Ranges: her Q 800, W 925, E 650, R 675 against your Q 700, E 925, W 600.
audit.corrected: Her E reaches only 650 — the W return window keeps you outside it. MR does not answer Splinter true damage; track the execute threshold as a number, not a bar.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Scatter the Weak 15s flat, Dark Sphere 7s flat, Unleashed Power 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement: content win[1..6] read LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Syndra/LeBlanc/Syndra while all seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill'.
audit.why: The content layer matches packet.levelChart exactly, including the genuine 'Skill' at row 0, so the full layer is the stale one.
audit.corrected: phases[1..6].side moved to match win[N] and the packet, with every why rewritten in the same proposal to argue the same verdict.
